title: standardize-retry-after-idempotency-for-streaming-and-tool-calls-openai-compat
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Inconsistent rate-limit responses and idempotency handling were causing client confusion and retry storms for streaming and tool/function-calling flows, especially under the OpenAI-compatibility layer. This PR standardizes Retry-After semantics, introduces consistent error codes for rate-limits and idempotency conflicts, and hardens streaming/tool-call paths to surface deterministic, machine-readable errors. Summary of changes: 1) Add standardized Retry-After header and JSON field (retry_after) across HTTP and streaming frames; 2) Unify idempotency key handling for /v1/functions and /v1/responses paths to return 409 with error.code="idempotency_conflict" and a human-friendly message when duplicate idempotency keys conflict with different payloads; 3) Normalize rate-limit responses to return error.code="rate_limit_exceeded" and include quota_metadata in OpenAI-compat responses; 4) Ensure streaming termination frames include structured error objects instead of opaque close reasons; 5) Update OpenAI-compat layer to map Redwood internal rate-limit tiers to OpenAI-compatible error structures while keeping Redwood-native headers; 6) Add end-to-end tests for streaming retry-after propagation and idempotency conflict detection; 7) Docs and SDK guidance updates for expected behavior and recommended client retry/backoff logic. Checklist: - [x] Implementation for HTTP API - [x] Streaming frame changes and backward-compatible framing - [x] OpenAI compatibility mapping - [x] SDK notes and example snippets (Python/TS) - [x] Unit + integration + e2e tests - [x] Updated docs + changelog Notes: This is conservative and backward-compatible: existing clients will still receive prior response shapes for non-OpenAI-compat routes; streaming frame change is additive (new "error" frame type) and includes legacy close codes for compatibility. See linked Linear tickets for rollout strategy and gating.

Aisha Patel (2026-02-13): Reply: centralized idempotency middleware added, stores origin request-id and linear-id; updated tests to cover replica consistency.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash on main. Merge commit: squash of 6 commits into a single change and updated CHANGELOG.md. Monitoring: feature gated under feature flag 'api.retry_after_v1' for gradual rollout.
release_notes: Standardized Retry-After semantics for HTTP + streaming, consistent idempotency conflict error (409 with error.code="idempotency_conflict"), OpenAI-compat mapping for rate-limit errors, streaming error frames now carry structured error objects, SDK docs updated with recommended retry/backoff patterns.
notes: Rollout plan: turn on behind feature flag in canary region for 72h, monitor rate_limit_exceeded spikes and idempotency_conflict counts
Operational: telemetry added to emit quota_metadata and idempotency_conflict samples to SLO dashboard
Client guidance: prefer exponential backoff with jitter; honor Retry-After header when present; for streaming clients, listen for 'error' frames and abort retry if idempotency_conflict is returned
